name: Foxfire

card.plain: Lv 1 -> Lv 2: you can keep two flames on screen at once.
card.frames: Lv 1 -> Lv 2: max flames on screen 1 -> 2

2.notes: Proposed (open question). Changes how you fight: stagger two flames to cover a jump. Alternative if the designer prefers a numeric step: recovery -10.

card.plain: Your flame passes through enemy projectiles.

notes: ONE file serves both fighters: source kitsune (A8), slot C so Ryo can draft it into C as a reward and the Tanuki can copy it (T0); data identical for whoever casts it (K3). Clip kitsune-foxfire (95 frames, hit 19) is the reference; Ryo's cast clip data/clips/ryo-foxfire-cast.json (92 frames, hit 16-19) differs in timing and would need the engine to use this data with his clip, since the validator ties frame data to one clip. Deviation from A table 15/4/30: startup 18 (+3), active - (projectile, release frame 19), recovery 77 (+47) because the clip is 95 frames with a held pose to frame 66; clip-matcher notes it could be cut to about 70 total (recovery 52). Projectile speed 5 units/tick (slow, proposed), spawn rect at the hand (about 50 cm = 100 units forward, chest height). Body hurtbox only: sleeves not added. Damage 70 from the A table; hitstun/blockstun placeholders. EX is a proposal: 2 hits.
